name: const unsafe fn split_at_mut_unchecked (& mut self , mid : usize) -> (& mut [T] , & mut [T])
rule: The caller must ensure that `0 <= mid <= self.len()`; calling `split_at_mut_unchecked` with an out-of-bounds `mid` is undefined behavior even if the resulting reference is not used.
api: impl < T > [T] { const unsafe fn split_at_mut_unchecked (& mut self , mid : usize) -> (& mut [T] , & mut [T]) }
